Priya (docs): starting a compact "Optimize Migration Cheatsheet" for customers moving from Legacy SDK -> Optimize toolkit. goal: one screen, three copy-paste snippets (batching policy, kv-prefetch, quant tip), a 3-step checklist, and links. quick takes?
Omar (eng): 👍 keep snippets minimal. include an auth + streaming header tip — folks forget Accept: text/event-stream.
Lin (opt): add a 1-line guidance on dynamic batching vs manual: when to trust auto and when to hard-cap.
Casey (pm): product line: "Expected benefits: lower p95, predictable cost. Caveat: monitor short-sequence latency." one sentence.
Priya (docs): drafting now. Omar, can you drop a 3-line kv-prefetch SDK snippet?
Omar (eng): paste this:```python
from redwood import Client
cli = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = cli.generate("summarize: 1-2 lines", prefetch_kv=True)
```
Priya (docs): nice. Lin, one-liner for quant?
Lin (opt): "Prefer int8 for bulk throughput when small quality delta acceptable; prefer fp16/bf16 for latency-sensitive short prompts. Always validate with a 50-sample smoke eval."
Priya (docs): added. batching JSON for server config (copy/paste):```json
{
  "batching_policy": {
    "max_batch_tokens": 4096,
    "min_requests": 2,
    "timeout_ms": 20
  }
}
```
Omar (eng): good. add a short note: if p95 climbs, try timeout_ms=10 and/or lower max_batch_tokens.
Priya (docs): done. checklist at top: 1) run 20-50 sample smoke eval, 2) enable prefetch on routes with high prefix reuse, 3) toggle dynamic batching or set manual caps.
Casey (pm): add rollback shortline: "Console > Deployments > Routes > promote prior variant." keep it brief.
docbot: PR #9537 opened by Priya — "optkit-migration-cheatsheet" (1 file). CI: docs-lint ok, linkcheck: 1 broken link.
Priya (docs): ack. likely an old telemetry path. Omar, canonical telemetry URL?
Omar (eng): use https://docs.redwood.ai/console/telemetry-guide. kv-prefetch canonical: https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize/kv-prefetch. update links.
Priya (docs): updated links in PR. added streaming auth example and note about SSE header.
Lin (opt): tiny add: short sentence on when to prefer manual batch: "use manual caps when your p95 is sensitive and traffic spikes cause large variance."
Omar (eng): nit: include a tiny code example for streaming headers:```http
GET /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY
Accept: text/event-stream
```
Priya (docs): added. re-run linkcheck.
docbot: linkcheck re-run passing. PR #9537 merged. :tada: 
Casey (pm): thanks. can we later add a small screenshot for the rollback step? open new ticket.
Priya (docs): will follow up in a docs-grooming ticket. closing thread. :shipit:"
